sessionComplete.title:
Nice work.
Session complete.

quotes.q1: Effort doesn't need to be perfect to count. It just needs to be repeated.
quotes.q2: The plan is not the goal. The plan is what gets you to the goal.
quotes.q3: Confidence isn't something you wait for. It's built session by session.
quotes.q4: You don't need to feel ready. You need to show up.
quotes.q5: Every hour you put in now is a mark you don't have to worry about later.
quotes.q6: The learner who plans beats the learner who panics — every time.
quotes.q7: Progress is not always visible. But it is always real.
quotes.q8: You are closer than you think.

sessionComplete.doneToday: You're done for today. Well done!
sessionComplete.noPenalty: Your call — there's no penalty either way.
